name: Free Studentship
benefit: - Class 11th - 12th (Arts & Commerce): ₹1,105/-. - Class 11th - 12th (Science): ₹1285/- - Degree General (Arts & Commerce): ₹1,375/-. - Degree Major (Arts & Commerce): ₹1,635/-. - Degree General (Science): ₹1,735/-. - Degree Major (Science): ₹2,235/-.
_eligibility_text:
1. The applicant should be a citizen of India.
1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Meghalaya.
1. The applicant should be a Student.
1. He/ She should belong to Scheduled Casts (SC)/ Scheduled Tribes (ST)/ Other Backward Classes (OBC). 
1. He/ She should be pursuing a regular course of studies in a recognized institution. 
1. The student's guardian/parents should be citizens of India.
1. He/she should not be receiving financial assistance from the Indian government's Post Matric Scholarship for SC/ST students and other government central and state scholarship schemes.
1. He/she should not be a government/non-government employee. 
1. He/she should not be a repeater in the same class more than once.
